translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content: Kuom jatend wer. Miwero gi gig wer man-gi tondegi. Zaburi mar Daudi.

content.text: Ka aluongi to yie idwoka,
yaye Nyasacha makare.
Konya e lit momako chunya;
yie ikecha kendo iwinj lamona.
Yaye, ubiro chayo duongʼ ka ukuodo wiya nyaka karangʼo?
Ubiro hero gik manono kendo luwo nyiseche manono nyaka karangʼo? Sela
Ngʼeuru ni Jehova Nyasaye oseyiera mondo abed mare owuon;
kendo Jehova Nyasaye winja, ka aluonge.
Ka iu owangʼ to kik utim richo;
seche ma uyweyo mos e kitandau,
to nonuru chunyu ka ulingʼ mos,
keturu chunyu mos ka unindo e kitandau. Sela
Chiwuru misengini mowinjore
kendo genuru kuom Jehova Nyasaye.
Ji mangʼeny penjo niya, “En ngʼa manyalo timonwa gimoro maber?”
Mad ler moa e lela wangʼi rieny kuomwa, yaye Jehova Nyasaye.
Isepongʼo chunya gi mor maduongʼ moloyo mor ma gin-go
e kinde ma gin-gi cham kod divai mangʼeny.
Abiro riera piny mi anind gi kwe,
nikech in kendi, yaye Jehova Nyasaye,
in ema imiyo adak gi kwe.
